nom: Bioderma Atoderm Shower Oil for very Dry to Atopic Skin

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or severely dry skin (including lymphedema-related dryness) most often report the shower oil relieves itching, flakiness, and tightness and leaves skin moisturized, though one dry-skinned user says it did not address her dryness issue and another with dry skin reports breakouts on legs, arms and chest.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin generally report no irritation and good tolerance despite the fragrance, though a few sensitive-skin or fragrance-sensitive users call the scent unbearable or find it irritating on the hands.
segments.combination: The two reviewers who specify combination skin describe the oil as light rather than heavy, useful as a gentle makeup remover for the face.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes that as her skin ages it has become drier and that this product helps keep it moisturized.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers using this for dryness, extreme dryness, or eczema-related dryness report clear relief, softer and moisturized skin, and reduced itching or flaking; one reviewer says it did not actually solve her dry-skin issue and had to use a separate lotion.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with eczema or atopic dermatitis report reduced flare-ups, less itchiness, and improved skin appearance with regular use, describing it as effective where steroids or other cleansers had failed; no barrier-related complaints appear beyond fragrance concerns.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product does not irritate her skin despite fragrance, and no reviewer reports increased redness, though several flag the fragrance itself as a general irritation risk for reactive skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with historically clear but dry skin reports new breakouts on legs, arms and chest after starting use, and another reports breakouts specifically on the upper back attributed to insufficient rinsing/emulsifying in that area; other reviewers report no such issue and one explicitly notes it does not treat acne.

aspects.libelle: Light, non-greasy skin feel after use
Lathers less than standard body wash, needs cloth
Large bottle lasts a long time, good value
Sticky or itchy residue on hands

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like it, but I have started to have breakouts on my legs, arms and chest when, historically, I've had clear but dry skin. I don't mind the scent and, honestly, like it. It emulsifies best with a wash cloth or loofah. It doesn't emulsify with just hands. I have normal to dry skin and slightly sensitive. It definitely helped me with my dry skin! Even my tattoo artist noticed how moisturized and hydrated my skin was during a leg tattoo. I paired it with the naturium bio lipid body lotion.

extraits.titre: Best Cleaning Oil in the Market
extraits.texte: I follow an influencer dermatologist named Lindsey Zubritsky, MD. In one of her reals she said this was a good cleninsing oil for dry skin. I used another body cleanser that is not from Ulta named ceramedx. However, it didn't last in terms of hydration on my skin, still got itchiness from my eczema. I tried this cleansing oil and it is so moisturizing. It does have some fragrance, however it goes away after you get out of the shower. This is so hydrating that I even skip moisturizer when I get out of the shower. My itchiness is completely gone. If you get dry skin during cold weather, I highly recommend this cleanser.

Really intense old lady fragrance that thankfully doesn't hang around once washed off. Works effectively in hard water when combined with a silicone scrubbie. Great at removing make up gently. It does cause break outs on my upper back, likely because its harder to reach to emulsify with the scrubbie, so I use an alternate cleanser there.

Most body washes make my skin slough off after I'm done showering (I've always assumed it's because they weren't moisturizing enough but perhaps it's an ingredient I'm sensitive to). This one not only doesn't do that, but it leaves my skin feeling super moisturized for about a day! It's even improved the mild keratosis pillaris on my arms. It does suds up, though not as readily as standard body washes. I am not a fan of the fragrance, but it goes away really quickly and isn't overpowering. Considering it's a body wash for people with atopic dermatitis, I'm surprised they didn't formulate it without fragrance. They should really consider removing the fragrance. Really I can't recommend it enough for people who suffer from dry skin and eczema or atopic dermatitis.

I have been suffering with irritated, dry, sensitive skin my whole life. For the last month I have been struggling with my skin and cerave wasn't touching it. I finally broke down and bought this. I had immediate relief and noticeable results in one use.

This is such a great body wash for dry skin. It's helped my dry skin stop itching and my skin truly feels moisturized. I highly recommend it especially if you have dry or sensitive skin! It does have a slight fragrance, but nothing too strong.

This is a nice product. It's most valuable as a makeup remover imo. Depending on what kind of water your home has, it may or may not gently lather. While it doesn't dry out your skin, it isn't doing anything to help with dry skin after bathing. I had success solving my dry skin area issues with AmLactin lotion.
